title: Rogue Agent: Attempt Discount on Empty Cart
invariantSummary: In state 'empty_cart', the only admissible transition is 'ADD_ITEM'. Probabilistic attempts to invoke discount mutations prior to cart initialization are mathematically impossible and strictly rejected.

expectedVerdictDetails.feedback: In state 'empty_cart', triggering 'APPLY_DISCOUNT' is mathematically impossible. The machine forbids this transition.
